decisions.reason: Responsive rules for website pages are a separate item in the source message; adding dashboard shell and canvas design coverage does not change those rules.
The visual foundation for additional website pages is separately requested and remains unchanged by the dashboard shell and canvas design request.
The source separately mentions completing responsive behavior for the original landing page; dashboard shell and canvas coverage does not alter that requirement.
The dashboard reference in the How It Works copy is descriptive content and is not changed by requesting visual design for the actual dashboard shell and canvas.
The source does not apply the dashboard shell and canvas design coverage to the landing-page visual system or change its established visual attributes.
Designing the dashboard shell and canvas does not change whether previously supplied follow-on copy belongs on the landing page.
The dashboard shell and canvas design request does not alter the landing-page sign-up button or its action.
